data.body: Closing for delivered scope (operator-approved Option A). The pin (change 2471 / commit 7501cc1d602d, `required-version = "==0.12.7"` in pyproject.toml + `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` guard in `make lint`) removed the version-determination fallback CI previously did on every run (`Could not determine uv version`), which was this bug's core defect. AC7 has been narrowed to that delivered check and ticked. Root cause attributed to ce5d (go uv-canonical) which set up uv in CI without pinning `required-version`, so setup-uv resolved the version remotely each run. RESIDUAL: setup-uv still fetches the version *manifest* from raw.githubusercontent.com for the artifact URL even when uv is pinned — a distinct mechanism, tracked separately in bug beribboned-enstatite-hoopoe (5caa); not in this ticket's scope.
